scope: Private loopback and translated-ARM64 diagnostics only

connector_rsa_diagnostic.purpose: Continue past a stale archived connector package whose RSA signature does not match the embedded verification key.

connector_certificate_diagnostic.purpose: Skip the expired historical GraalWeb trust bundle while studying later connector behavior.

force_nonpremium_initialization.purpose: Run the existing startup branch that clears the native loading flag.

render_boundary_loading_clear.purpose: Clear the loading flag immediately before the normal JNI draw decision.

experiments.name: Certificate bypass only
experiments.observed: The connector moved to HTTPS port 443 but remained on the splash screen.
experiments.verdict: The expired certificate is real, but it is not the only startup failure.

experiments.name: Certificate bypass plus longer connect poll
experiments.observed: The client still remained on the splash screen.
experiments.verdict: A zero-second poll timeout is not sufficient to explain the complete failure.

experiments.name: Force HTTPS through HTTP transport
experiments.observed: The request reached the local HTTP listener but the client still remained on the splash screen until the package and RSA checks were handled separately.
experiments.verdict: Changing transport alone is not a repair.

experiments.name: Blocking socket I/O
experiments.verdict: Rejected because it changes the asynchronous client design.

experiments.name: Handler-pair operand swap
experiments.observed: The xchg experiment made the local protocol less correct. IDA, decoded bytecode, and the working no-swap replay agree on packet type first and handler index second.
experiments.verdict: Rejected. The original handler table is correct for this revision.

experiments.name: Non-premium initialization branch
experiments.observed: The ARM64-only diagnostic completed connector, encrypted login, map, level, image, and heartbeat traffic, then rendered the tiled world and HUD through the x86_64 emulator translation layer when given the exact .gmap fixture.
experiments.verdict: Best local loading-state candidate. Physical ARM64 and live service checks remain open.

experiments.name: Render-boundary loading clear
experiments.observed: The same translated-ARM64 world and HUD rendered after the flag was cleared at the JNI draw boundary.
experiments.verdict: Useful control that proves the draw gate, not a release repair.

production_boundary: Obtain a current connector response for the exact client query.
Validate its package signature against the authorized current key.
Replace the historical trust bundle with a current authorized chain while retaining hostname verification.
Confirm the loading-state behavior on a real ARM64 device with an authorized account and service endpoint.
